short: negated auxiliary in caveats (does not / cannot)
notes: Card: ' do' x4, ' does' x3, ' don' x3 in notes and code comments ('does not replace information', 'we cannot send', 'we do not know the value', "or don't work at all"). Probe: '# ... since we do not know the path' 0.894, 'does not replace a doctor's visit' 0.721, 'we cannot send gift cards' 0.647; affirmative versions 0.179-0.225, 'Keep your rules short and to the point' 0.400, casual 'I don't think' 0.057.
